Temperature (and Humidity) chambers – AR series
Producent
ESPEC Corporation
Grupa urządzeń
Climatic Test Chambers
Zastosowanie
Temperature and Humidity Tests
 Categories: Application, Climatic Test Chambers, ESPEC Corporation, Group, Supplier/Make, Temperature and Humidity Tests
The family of temperature (and humidity) chambers AR series covers up to 12 different models with next volumes 220, 390, 680 and 1100 liters. Wide range of parameters, high quality of temperature and humidity control, high speed of changing temperatures with Japanese precision of construction and reability makes, that those chambers can fulfill most demanded test specifications.
Features
Features:
Volumes 220, 390, 680 i 1100 litres,
Versions – with humidity control or temperature control only,
Minimum temperature -45 or -75 °C,
Speed of changing temperature: at least 4 degrees per minute,
Maximum temperature: +180 °C,
Relative humidity control range from 10 to 98 %RH,
Test chamber and housing made from stainless steel,
Air cooled refrigeration system,
High precission of temperature and humidity,
N-Instrumentation controller with touch screen TFT 16,5 cm,
Possibility of controlling the chamber by using external sensor which is measurint the specimen temperature.
Controller: N-Instrumentation: 
Colour touch screen TFT 16,5 cm,
Possibility of programming up to 40 user programs, each with up to 99 steps,
Ethernet Interface – build in web server Web Manager, possibility of programming kontrolling and monitoring by using web browser – possibility of local work with using PC connected directly to the chamber,
USB 2.0 Interface – possibility of connecting flash memmory type (pendrive) – saving parameters during test, reading and saving of programs, possibility of editing programs on external PC and transferring them back to the chamber, back-trace finction: function of tracking errors in case of alarms with saving them for remote diagnositics for servicing purposes, included software for PC desired for making programs, reading, archivisation and editing (i.e. makings graphs) datas saved during the test.
Fittings:
1 stainless steel shelf,
Feets and adjustable wheels,
Two cable ports 100 mm in both side walls,
Build In tank for water for humidity controll system,
Overheat thermostat preventing the samples against high temperature,
Condenser filter.
Options
Additional stainless stell shelves,
Wieving window with lighting,
Additional cable ports in side walls and ceiling,
Temperature and humidity recorders.
